form.label: AI-Powered Security Operations Center — Live Threat Monitoring and Incident Response
form.description: Real-time SOC command center for detection, investigation, AI triage, MITRE ATTACK coverage and response readiness across Windows, Linux, web and network telemetry.

div.p: Unified threat detection, AI triage and incident response across the enterprise attack surface

search.query: (index=windows OR index=linux OR index=web OR index=suricata OR index=ai_triage OR index=security_alerts) | stats count
index=ai_triage event_type="ai_triage_result" severity IN (high,critical) | stats count
(index=windows OR index=linux OR index=web OR index=suricata OR index=ai_triage OR index=security_alerts) | stats dc(index) as sources
((index=windows source="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625) OR (index=linux ("Failed password" OR "authentication failure"))) | stats count

(index=suricata OR index=security_alerts OR index=ai_triage OR (index=windows (EventCode=4625 OR "-EncodedCommand" OR "certutil.exe")) OR (index=linux ("Failed password" OR "authentication failure")) OR (index=web ("%27" OR "<script" OR "%3Cscript" OR "../"))) | eval detection_source=case(index="suricata","IDS",index="windows","Endpoint",index="linux","Identity",index="web","Web",index="ai_triage","AI triage",true(),"Detection") | timechart span=1m count by detection_source limit=8 useother=f

(index=windows OR index=linux OR index=web OR index=suricata OR index=ai_triage OR index=security_alerts) | stats count latest(_time) as last_seen by index | eval age_seconds=now()-last_seen | eval status=case(age_seconds<=300,"ONLINE",age_seconds<=900,"DEGRADED",true(),"OFFLINE") | convert ctime(last_seen) | rename index as sensor count as events | table sensor status events last_seen | sort sensor

(index=windows OR index=linux OR index=web OR index=suricata OR index=security_alerts) | rex field=_raw "from\s+(?<ssh_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | rex field=_raw "^(?<web_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | rex field=_raw "<Data[^>]+Name=.IpAddress.[^>]*>(?<windows_ip>[^<]+)" | eval source_ip=coalesce(src_ip,source_ip,clientip,ssh_ip,web_ip,windows_ip) | where isnotnull(source_ip) | where NOT cidrmatch("10.0.0.0/8",source_ip) AND NOT cidrmatch("172.16.0.0/12",source_ip) AND NOT cidrmatch("192.168.0.0/16",source_ip) AND NOT cidrmatch("127.0.0.0/8",source_ip) | iplocation source_ip | where isnotnull(lat) AND isnotnull(lon) | geostats latfield=lat longfield=lon count by index

table.title: Internal lab sources — private IPs cannot be geolocated

search.query: (index=windows OR index=linux OR index=web OR index=suricata OR index=security_alerts) | rex field=_raw "from\s+(?<ssh_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | rex field=_raw "^(?<web_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | rex field=_raw "<Data[^>]+Name=.IpAddress.[^>]*>(?<windows_ip>[^<]+)" | eval source_ip=coalesce(src_ip,source_ip,clientip,ssh_ip,web_ip,windows_ip) | where cidrmatch("10.0.0.0/8",source_ip) OR cidrmatch("172.16.0.0/12",source_ip) OR cidrmatch("192.168.0.0/16",source_ip) OR cidrmatch("127.0.0.0/8",source_ip) | eval asset=case(source_ip="10.0.10.129","Kali attacker",source_ip="10.0.10.20","Web server",source_ip="10.0.10.10","SOC server",source_ip="127.0.0.1" OR source_ip="::1","Local endpoint",true(),"Internal asset") | stats count latest(_time) as last_seen values(index) as indexes by source_ip asset | convert ctime(last_seen) | sort 0 - count

(index=windows OR index=linux OR index=web OR index=suricata OR index=ai_triage OR index=security_alerts) | eval telemetry=case(index="windows","WINDOWS / SYSMON",index="linux","LINUX AUTH",index="web","DVWA / APACHE",index="suricata","SURICATA IDS",index="ai_triage","AI TRIAGE",true(),upper(index)) | eval event_preview=substr(replace(_raw,"[\r\n]+"," "),1,220) | table _time telemetry host source sourcetype event_preview | sort 0 - _time | head 100
(index=windows OR index=linux OR index=web OR index=suricata OR index=ai_triage OR index=security_alerts) | timechart span=1m count by index limit=10 useother=f

(index=windows OR index=linux OR index=web OR index=suricata OR index=security_alerts) | rex field=_raw "from\s+(?<ssh_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | rex field=_raw "^(?<web_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | rex field=_raw "<Data[^>]+Name=.IpAddress.[^>]*>(?<windows_ip>[^<]+)" | eval source_ip=coalesce(src_ip,source_ip,clientip,ssh_ip,web_ip,windows_ip) | where isnotnull(source_ip) AND source_ip!="-" | top limit=10 source_ip

(index=windows source="WinEventLog:Security") OR (index=linux ("Failed password" OR "Accepted password" OR "authentication failure")) | rex field=_raw "<EventID[^>]*>(?<event_id>\d+)</EventID>" | rex field=_raw "<Data[^>]+Name=.IpAddress.[^>]*>(?<windows_ip>[^<]+)" | rex field=_raw "<Data[^>]+Name=.TargetUserName.[^>]*>(?<windows_user>[^<]+)" | rex field=_raw "(?:(?:Failed|Accepted) password for (?:invalid user )?)(?<linux_user>\S+) from (?<linux_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | eval source_ip=coalesce(windows_ip,linux_ip), user=coalesce(windows_user,linux_user) | eval result=case(event_id="4624","SUCCESS",event_id="4625","FAILURE",match(_raw,"Accepted password"),"SUCCESS",true(),"FAILURE") | table _time host user source_ip result source | sort 0 - _time | head 100
